body: Understandable business, durable high ROIC (moat), owner-minded honest management, price below conservative intrinsic value (margin of safety), long hold. Munger: long-run return ≈ ROC (6% vs 18%). Structural edge: insurance float ~1.7x leverage at below T-bill cost; never forced to sell. Buffett's Alpha: Sharpe 0.79; alpha insignificant after BAB+QMJ.
title: Buffett & Munger: quality at a fair price
